note: Practical priors about bowfishing are hypotheses until validated on field data; fit-for-purpose targets are pre-declared requirements, not achievements.
role: Wind, gusts and surface exposure at the shoreline
bowfishingPurpose: Wind decides whether a night trip is practical: chop breaks up the light on the surface and hides fish, and strong wind makes boat control and shots unsafe; protected shorelines stay fishable when open water is not.
mustNotPredict: wave height without an over-water reference

fitForPurpose.metric: probability of detection of strong-wind nights
fitForPurpose.rationale: missing a strong-wind night is the costly error

fitForPurpose.metric: nights with observation coverage near the lake

priorityQuestions: How often is a given lake calm at night by month (climatology)?
Can fetch-based exposure be validated with bank observations?
